name: Africa Media Hub
platforms: Android 8+ universal development APK · Android / Fire TV · Web · Desktop builds
description: Africa Creates. The World Connects. Discover live television, news, music, movies and family entertainment through Africa Media Hub.
features: Live channel guide and search by country
TV mode with remote navigation and numbered channel selection
Last-watched startup, favorite channels and previous-channel recall
Low-data mode and playback recovery for compatible streams
Provider links with in-app and external viewing options
Device-specific installation guidance and available downloads
Pair an Android phone with compatible Android / Fire TV and install directly
Desktop active LAN scan and MAC information where available
My Streaming profile-private cameras with outbound gateway snapshots
limitations: Development-signed APK; physical TV pairing/install testing pending. TV debugging and approval required. Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Roku and Apple TV cannot use Android APKs. Camera remote viewing requires a paired always-on LAN gateway and provides snapshots, without audio. Signing conflicts with older builds may prevent an update; existing apps are never automatically uninstalled.
release_notes: Android phone-to-TV pairing and APK transfer; LAN device identification; private profile camera snapshots through a gateway.
